clean_body: | Folks — It’s not much of an exaggeration to say House Republicans are making a mess of Congress. Marjorie Taylor Greene recently announced that she’s done with Speaker Mike Johnson and is threatening to depose him. Keep in mind, this is after a contingent of far-right Republicans threw out Speaker Kevin McCarthy last fall — and took weeks to appoint a replacement. And this weekend, Mike Johnson was able to pass a bill offering aid to Ukraine — but only with the help of House Democrats. Now, the wrath of House Republicans against their own Speaker is growing, with more GOP members joining the calls to depose Johnson. Meanwhile, the Senate is working hard to protect healthcare access, combat climate change, increase gun control, and defend the integrity of our democracy. It’s crystal clear: Things get done when Democrats hold the majority. That’s why Tina is working tirelessly to protect the Democratic Senate majority and flip the House from red to blue. Fellow Conservative,

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress is a tale as old as the movie industry itself.

clean_body: My opponent likes to talk about how out-of-state interests impact Montana, but the real issue is Tester himself. | Fellow Conservative, Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress is a tale as old as the movie industry itself. You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry. My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support. I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. In her fundraising appeals on behalf of Jon Tester’s campaign, she writes, “Jon Tester is running for reelection in Montana—it’s the most important race on the map. This election will determine the future of our country, and I can’t sit on the sidelines with stakes as high as these.” Please consider a contribution to my campaign today. Is it the Hollywood, coastal California elite, or the people of Montana who sent him to Washington to be their voice? With A-LIST Hollywood celebrities on his team, there is no telling the amount of resources Tester will be able to marshal over the next seven months. I appreciate your help with this matter. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. | | Like so many Oregonians, I have a deep, unwavering appreciation for the natural beauty of our state and the endless outdoor spaces and opportunities it has to offer. **That's why this Earth Day, I'm as committed as ever to protecting our great state's clean air, water, and land for future generations.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83535110/468703040/-2044921950?refcode=2024-04-22-earth&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=66023d8a-0601-ef11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NjAyM2Q4YS0wNjAxLWVmMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vhfsBKarfuup8Dtl8iIe9POlZ0HLLpZ4hKZL0giUP8g=) It's not enough to simply defend Oregon's rivers and mountains, or its coasts and valleys. All of us _must_ be a part of a greater movement to save our planet and tackle the climate crisis by moving toward a clean energy future with good-paying green jobs. That's why I was so proud to lead the charge in passing my clean energy tax credits into law under the Inflation Reduction Act, which marked the biggest climate action of our generation. I'll keep pushing for more transformative policies that make cleaner air, water and communities a reality. I know that big polluters and climate deniers aren't going to stop trying to slow down climate action. **That's why we can't ever let up – we can't take our state, country, and planet for granted, and we must create a world with opportunities that are sustainable.** On this Earth Day, let's remember: we only have one planet, so let's protect it with all we've got. ---|---|---
Seven years ago, I joined more than 30,000 others to travel the 26.2 miles from Hopkinton to Boston on foot. Unlike the many experienced runners who qualify to run in the Boston Marathon, I was part of a large group of charity runners supporting non-profit organizations. In fact, prior to running the race, I probably wouldn't have even called myself a runner. You see, I don't particularly like running...and 26.2 miles, heck, I'm not a fan of even driving that far.
Nevertheless, on April 17, 2017, I successfully made the journey on foot, crossing the Boylston Street finish line 4 hours, 51 minutes and 22 seconds after leaving Hopkinton. And while one of the main reasons I ran the race was to show my kids that hard work and preparation can overcome many challenges, I learned a great deal more than I taught them. I can confidently say it was one of the most powerful experiences I've had during my time on this planet.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a5be9a1-bbc0-4b1e-81dd-57bace412a76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
April 17, 2017; Boston, MA.
The race continues to remind me that life is an unending series of tradeoffs. During the almost five hours of time I had to think about them on that Marathon Monday, I was constantly reminded that one's approach to these tradeoffs matters. And as any decision-making theorist will remind you, our perspective is always biased. About a month after the race, I took the time to write up 26 lessons I (re)learned on the road to Boston and wanted to share them again here:
1. _**Social pressures and verbal commitment are powerful forces**_. I initially refused to tell anyone I was running the race, always wanting the option of dropping out without embarrassment. But once I started telling people, I trained more intensely and consistently.
2. While I had at first thought of my friends, family, and fans as there to support me, I realized the race came to represent some of their own challenges, goals and hopes. It brought me closer to almost everyone I told. Many thanked me for including them, and the interactions brought additional meaning to my efforts.
3. It takes a village to organize a marathon. Over 9,000 volunteers helped race organizers pull off this year's event...and they're all supportive, encouraging, and smiling. I tip my hat to the folks at the Boston Athletic Association for their efforts.
4. The 26.2 miles of cheering fans are a powerful force for good. Signs such as "If Trump can run..." to "Run like United Airlines security is chasing you!" provided much needed smiles and motivation. And of course, what's not to love about hundreds of Wellesley students holding "Kiss me!" signs?
5. Given there was zero chance of my winning the race, the competition really became one of me vs. me. _**The discipline of running one 's own race is a skill worth honing, both on and off the marathon course**._ Every person should determine their own definition of success.
6. All marathoners, regardless of citizenship, are Bostonians on Patriots day...and if you doubt this, try listening to hundreds of runners from around the world sing "Sweet Caroline" in unison while running through Framingham; it will remove any doubts.
7. Temperature matters. Running intensely can add ~20 degrees to the temperature you perceive. The relative heat on Marathon Monday was a shock to me, and many other first-timers. _Yet another reminder to think through various scenarios and conditions when preparing for an uncertain environment!_
8. Heartbreak Hill is misleading. It should be plural. There are several heartbreaking hills.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..apBAm6V2mIS1X278r9sdfcfO4eP6hYTWw7r-uToh9Qk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=143873689)
9. Almost anyone can train their body to run 26.2 miles. Barring medical complications, the training really is about putting in the miles. I'm living proof you don't have to be a stellar athlete to finish the race.
10. _**It 's important to see the big picture.**_ When my ankle started bugging me along the race, I caught a glimpse of a veteran with one leg running on a prosthetic. When my glasses fogged up and my contact lenses bothered me, I noticed a blind runner. _Perspective matters, and our own perspective is never objective_.
11. David Ortiz said what Boston has always believed: "[This is our f&*ck&ng city! And no one is going to dictate our freedom](https://substack.com/redirect/8f8fca0f-697c-408f-aa5b-d874da76b386?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Not the King of England. Not Islamic terrorists from Watertown. Boston has always been strong; Patriots Day makes this crystal clear.
12. For slower runners like me, the risk of drinking too much fluid is greater than drinking too little. [And drinking too much can be dangerous, possibly even fatal, if your sodium levels drop too low](https://substack.com/redirect/e38a7498-927b-48cc-ba51-f8dda21f599c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Who knew?
13. As a first-time marathoner, I found Boston's underdog mentality overwhelming and empowering. One fan held a poster with "Patriots 3, Falcons 28" at the base of Heartbreak Hill. Other fans blasted [Toby Keith's "How do you like me now?"](https://substack.com/redirect/c8313b89-d579-404c-b2b8-04ae0bbbf9ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from speakers alongside the course.
14. _**Self-nudging works.**_ There were several times between Boston College and Boylston Street that I doubted my ability to finish the race. But knowing my kids were at the finish line meant I couldn't not finish. How could I face them if I didn't get there?
15. To witness the best of human determination, visit the finish line area after the grandstands are gone, the roads are open, and some runners are still working on getting to the finish line. It's among the purest forms of grit and persistence I've ever witnessed; while elite runners are impressive, these runners are inspiring.
16. The charity runner program is brilliant. It raises tens of millions of dollars for local Boston charities and helps beginning runners participate in the storied race. It has the added benefit of creating deep psychological obligations for those runners to finish... (One of my donors indicated his gift would be prorated for miles covered!)

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..apBAm6V2mIS1X278r9sdfcfO4eP6hYTWw7r-uToh9Qk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=143873689)
17. The body knows best. I developed an ability to listen to my body that proved essential to deciding when to "work through the pain" rather than taking time off. No doctor, book, or website can develop that judgment. _**Sometimes it 's best to ignore the rules and follow your instinct.**_
18. Age matters less than you might think. At one point when I was felt I could go no further, a 70-something woman put her hand on my shoulder and said "You got this...let's go...I'll run with you for a bit" and got me moving again.
19. Thank god for [Marathon Sports on Boylston Street](https://substack.com/redirect/0a212680-a753-4499-9443-a9b5297401dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The specialized knowledge and experience that every staff member has is amazing. And not just for shoes...but when and where to use BodyGlide, how to run on packed snow vs. icy slush, what to wear when, which hydration strategy works best in various conditions, and many other topics.
20. Not all endurance gels are the same. The salted watermelon GU is pretty good, as is Jet Blackberry. And the ROCTANE GUs are particularly useful for squeezing in much needed amino acids and sodium, with a bonus bit of caffeine. Also, in case you're wondering, taking multiple GUs does not make you go faster!
21. _**Sometimes it 's best to keep things simple.**_You might think the relative lack of equipment in running means preparing for a marathon is a streamlined, low-cost endeavor. Not true. It's easy to get distracted by gear. GPS watches that might be able to identify ovulation cycles, flux-capacitor inspired running shoes, and high tech jackets that breathe but are also safe in outer space are all eager to take a bite out of your wallet. Almost all market to "spending more will make you faster" hopes.
22. My college squash coach David Talbott once reminded me to "get in shape to play squash, don't play squash to get in shape." Also true for marathoning. Get in shape to run a marathon, don't run a marathon to get in shape. But the training can kick-start a virtuous fitness cycle; I no longer dislike running.
23. Prior to the soreness-inducing long training runs, I had never fully-appreciated the power of foam rollers to release muscle tension. It made a ton of difference in my ability to recover enough to keep training. And an ice bath, which provides sheer joy to children tasked with dumping ice into a tub containing a parent, can reduce inflammation and soreness.

24. **Reactions matter as much, if not more, than challenges**. How people respond to unexpected adversity tells a great deal about their character. Mike Tyson had it right when he said "Everyone has a plan until they get punched in the face." _Along the course, I saw hundreds of people getting "punched in the face." And I saw hundreds regroup, set a new plan, and persist._ Many runners had overcome serious life challenges before the race and shared their stories on their shirts.
25. As the movie _Patriot 's Day_ makes clear, love may be the only thing that can overcome hate, especially in matters of potential violence against innocent masses. This spirit of support literally oozes from everywhere on Patriots Day and smothers marathoners and fans alike. If you've never experienced it, try to run or watch the race at some point in your life.
26. There's dignity and power in acknowledging mistakes, even decades after making them. Kathrine Switzer, the first woman to run the Boston Marathon, had officials literally trying to rip her bib off during the 1967 race. body:
Big news for Earth Day!
#
In 2021, Alexandria and Senator Ed Markey proposed a Civilian Climate Corps — a New Deal-style jobs training program to employ young people in good-paying, union jobs combating the climate crisis.
Naysayers immediately called the idea ‘unrealistic’.
But today, Alexandria, Senator Markey, and Senator Bernie Sanders stood with President Biden to announce that **the American Climate Corps has officially launched** — and thousands of new jobs in the clean energy industry of tomorrow have officially started hiring.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240422.JVaXNE&refcode=em20240422-6247-P_FND_CTR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6247%2E2526796%2EkN2Srm)
Now, young Americans of all backgrounds will have the chance to take on the climate crisis while training for union careers, no matter their previous experience.
Our movement is beginning to crack the grip of fossil fuels on our politics, and **we’re building an economy that works for each and every one of us along the way**.
[Will you make a $5 contribution today to power Alexandria's fight for the livable future we all deserve? Every single contribution helps leverage our grassroots movement into real policy actions.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240422.JVaXNE&refcode=em20240422-6247-P_FND_CTR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6247%2E2526796%2EkN2Srm)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240422.JVaXNE&refcode=em20240422-6247-P_FND_CTR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6247%2E2526796%2EkN2Srm)**
Inspired by the Civilian Conservation Corps, a revolutionary infrastructure program started by FDR that provided jobs for millions while drastically improving public lands throughout the U.S., the American Climate Corps will expand to employ over 20,000 young people in high-demand skills in the climate resiliency sector.
The program is also designed to invest in and attract participants from frontline communities disproportionately impacted by the climate crisis.1
This is a major victory for our movement. **But there’s a lot more to be done**.
[Ideas like the Climate Corps are called ‘unrealistic’, but we can win a better world because of every single person who is demanding change. Can you contribute $5 today so we can keep organizing for a sustainable planet?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240422.JVaXNE&refcode=em20240422-6247-P_FND_CTR_GND&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6247%2E2526796%2EkN2Srm)

Whether or not you can donate today, thank you for standing with our movement for a brighter future for all.
Happy Earth Day,
Team AOC

clean_body: Big news for Earth Day! In 2021, Alexandria and Senator Ed Markey proposed a Civilian Climate Corps — a New Deal-style jobs training program to employ young people in good-paying, union jobs combating the climate crisis. Naysayers immediately called the idea ‘unrealistic’. But today, Alexandria, Senator Markey, and Senator Bernie Sanders stood with President Biden to announce that the American Climate Corps has officially launched — and thousands of new jobs in the clean energy industry of tomorrow have officially started hiring. Now, young Americans of all backgrounds will have the chance to take on the climate crisis while training for union careers, no matter their previous experience. Our movement is beginning to crack the grip of fossil fuels on our politics, and we’re building an economy that works for each and every one of us along the way. Inspired by the Civilian Conservation Corps, a revolutionary infrastructure program started by FDR that provided jobs for millions while drastically improving public lands throughout the U.S., the American Climate Corps will expand to employ over 20,000 young people in high-demand skills in the climate resiliency sector. The program is also designed to invest in and attract participants from frontline communities disproportionately impacted by the climate crisis.1 This is a major victory for our movement. But there’s a lot more to be done. Whether or not you can donate today, thank you for standing with our movement for a brighter future for all. Happy Earth Day, Team AOC 1 - | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2s6ir9soorftq1avm9a1fb5ra9b1pno3klmfr3g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c3hm2or1clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

**_Have you given up?_**

You’re probably wondering why I’m asking such a blunt question . . .

**_FIRST_** – to make sure I got your attention.

**_SECOND_** – because this is an _EMERGENCY_ , and I’m counting on you to respond IMMEDIATELY!

You see, pro-abortion radicals are bragging they have 2024 in the bag – pointing to news headlines like the one I saw in _The Wall Street Journal_ recently, which stated, “ _Support for Abortion Access is Near Record, WSJ-NORC poll finds_.”

_They say polls like this PROVE that YOU don’t care about fighting President Biden’s radical pro-abortion agenda or protecting the lives of precious little preborn boys and girls anymore_!

**If this isn’t true – _which I hope and pray it’s not_ – I need you to help me prove them _DEAD WRONG_ before it’s too late!**

I’m worried this is a big reason why so many of our supposed allies are running scared from the abortion issue ahead of the November elections. All they’re going to succeed in doing is deflating the pro-life base of voters they need to win!

If that happens, the Abortion Lobby could very well walk away with ALL of the power they need to impose abortion-on-demand up until the moment of birth in every state in the country – __all paid for by taxpayers like you and me_!_

**[That’s why I’ve linked your personal PRO-LIFE SURVEY, which is coded and specifically registered for pro-life grassroots Americans like you](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-y/).**

Please complete your **[PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-j/) ** _IMMEDIATELY_ because I’m counting on you to tell me exactly where you stand!

I know the Abortion Lobby LIES.

They do all the time – like when they claimed with a straight face that they DON’T sell off the organs of the little boys and girls they butcher after secretly-recorded videos showed Planned Parenthood executives doing exactly that.

_Planned Parenthood Senior Executive Dr. Mary Gatter even joked, “I want a Lamborghini,” while discussing how much money she’d make from selling aborted babies’ body parts_!

These are people who butcher innocent little boys and girls for a living.

**__Am I really supposed to believe they have some moral qualm against LYING_?_**

And as for the media’s truthfulness, _where do I even start_?

One recent Gallup poll I saw showed **_SEVEN PERCENT_** of Americans have “a great deal” of trust in the media.

**_A whopping 93% DON’T_.**

_Frankly, when I read that poll, I wondered how the heck 7% of Americans actually trust the media?!?!_

So, no . . . I don’t believe anything the Abortion Lobby or the media is saying about you.

_Everything in my gut tells me they’re lying!_

But I also know that if they ARE right _(or any more of allies in Washington, D.C. start to believe their lies because I can’t PROVE them wrong),_ _you and I will be facing an all-out DISASTER_.

That’s because **_YOU_** are the ONLY thing standing in the way of President Biden’s radical pro-abortion agenda – you and millions of other pro-lifers across the country.

**And if you DON’T have any more fight left in you, 2024 will be a DISASTER, and the Abortion Lobby will get _everything_ they want.**

That’s exactly what they’re banking on . . .

**[So, please help me prove them wrong by clicking HERE to fill out your PRO-LIFE SURVEY right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-i/)!**

Pro-Life Friend, the Abortion Lobby and their allies are more emboldened than ever right now.

In fact, you may have seen the news from a few weeks ago about how Kamala Harris just became the first Vice President in U.S. history to visit an abortion facility.

As she spoke to the press inside a building where innocent little boys and girls are slaughtered, Vice President Harris had the audacity to blast pro-life laws for being “immoral” – _as if protecting innocent life is evil!_

_And as for President Biden . . . the _Associated Press_ reported, “President Joe Biden’s campaign is betting big on abortion rights as a major driver for Democrats in the election_.”

President Biden even kicked off his _State of the Union_ address promising to impose abortion-through-all-nine-months laws on the entire country!

**You and I don’t have to guess what he means or how far he’ll go.**

President Biden is on record supporting the so-called _"Women’s Health Protection Act"_ (H.R. 12) – better named the Abortion at Any Time Act or "_Roe 2.0_.”

As I alluded to earlier, if passed, this radical scheme would FORCE legalized abortion-on-demand . . .

. . . on every state in the country . . .

. . . up until the moment of birth . . .

. . . all paid for by YOUR hard-earned tax dollars!

In fact, pro-abortion Democrats in the House of Representatives have even filed a Discharge Petition to FORCE the _Abortion at Any Time Act_ through the U.S. House – even if GOP House Leaders try to stand in the way.

_**Under House rules, if a simple majority of the House agrees, H.R. 12 could be immediately brought to the floor for a vote**_**!**

The Abortion Lobby and their allies introduced this radical bill because they can smell the FEAR from many of our supposed “pro-life” allies.

_They think many would rather wave the white flag on abortion than dare to stand up to them_!

**That’s why the Abortion Lobby’s claims that you’ve given up are so worrisome to me right now.**

If you really have left the battle, there’s no way I can convince our allies to stand strong against President Biden’s pro-abortion radicalism.

The result will be that many grassroots pro-lifers around the country will grow disillusioned.

They’ll think their votes won’t really matter, and there isn’t really much difference between the candidates.

Needless to say, this will dramatically hurt turnout in November . . .

**_And you and I could be facing an outright DISASTER_.**

As I mentioned, I don’t think any of this is true . . . I don’t think you’ve given up.

_Instead, I believe these lies are designed for one purpose – to convince weak-kneed Republicans to cave on the abortion issue_!

But I can’t PROVE them wrong if you and other pro-lifers across the country won’t **[fill out your specially registered PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-d/).**

I can hardly begin to explain how critical this is . . .

_As I write to you, the Abortion Lobby and their pals are telling everyone who will listen that the Pro-Life Movement is fading away!_

Of course, the thousands of students we train every year to take on the fight against abortion shows that the Pro-Life Movement is actually growing.

**But stopping the Abortion Lobby’s schemes also depends on grassroots pro-lifers like you who are willing to give sacrificially and take action.**

_So, will you join our students in making your voice heard in Washington, D.C.?

Will you PLEASE help?_

The fact is, pro-abortion Democrats are more emboldened than ever because they believe they have the upper hand.

Worse yet, they say Americans like you don’t care enough to help!

_Are they right? Or will you fight?_

If you still think preborn lives are precious and worth fighting for, **[please fill out your PRO-LIFE SURVEY and make your most generous contribution IMMEDIATELY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-h/).**

Your financial contribution is critical.

While Planned Parenthood has U.S. taxpayers and deep-pocketed Hollywood elites bankrolling them, I depend on the generosity of good folks like you.

So, I need EVERY _Students for Life Action_ supporter to respond immediately.

**I’ve stretched _Students for Life Action’s_ resources to contact you and other select Americans whom I believe will NEVER roll over for the Abortion Lobby’s agenda.**

I know not everyone will respond with their survey.

_Some people will surely be tempted to think someone else will fight this fight and carry the load_.

Others will naively believe that there’s no way our allies would ever cave on abortion _(as if pro-lifers have never been stabbed in the back before)._

But I don’t believe you are like that.

I’ve also identified nearly 10 million families I believe would join our fight against abortion this year if I can reach them – by _mail_ , by _email_ , by _online ads_ , _social media_ , and even by _radio_ and _TV_ if possible.

But without your financial help, I’ll never be able to.

**My hope is you care enough to contribute sacrificially, so I can reach these families.**

The good news is, the more you give, the more “bang for your buck” you get because discounts increase the larger our projects are.

For example, **[a generous gift of $25 will let _Students for Life Action_ reach 44 more families](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-k/).

[$50 will help us rally more than 92 homes](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-u/).

[A special gift of $100 will generate over 208 pro-life contacts](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-o/).

[And a major contribution of $1,000 will reach as many as 3,007 pro-lifers](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-b/).

_[$5,000 will reach over 15,400](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-n/)!_**

Of course, I don’t know what you can afford.

All I ask you to do is give what you can.

With the stakes so high, I’ve asked all of our members and supporters to go above and beyond what they’ve given in the past.

In fact, **[I’m hoping you’ll consider giving $250](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-p/)** , which I know is a tremendous amount to ask for.

Of course, **[if that’s not possible, could you please agree to $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-x/)?**

**[Or could you at minimum agree to a gift of $75](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-m/)?**

Whatever you can best afford today, I hope you will send it with your completed **[PRO-LIFE SURVEY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-c/).**

The Abortion Lobby believes that you have given up in the battle to protect innocent little preborn boys and girls – and now support abortion!

_You must let Congress, the Washington, D.C. media elites, and even the White House know that this is nothing more than a LIE before it’s too late_.

**[So, please fill out your PRO-LIFE SURVEY and make your most generous contribution of $100, $75, or at least $50 IMMEDIATELY](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-q/).**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – The Abortion Lobby and their pals in the media claim you’ve given up. With many Republicans running scared from the abortion issue, it’s clear many of our allies believe them.

I hope it is not true! **[Please fill out your PRO-LIFE SURVEY right away so I can prove the Abortion Lobby is lying about you](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-a/).**

**[And please make your contribution of $100, $75, or $50 to help me mobilize thousands of others to stand up to the Abortion Lobby](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glydyhd-duchtdja-f/)!**

| Dear Friends & Supporters, On May 27th, the World Health Organization will vote on the International Pandemic Treaty and International Health Regulations. We don't need the WHO or any other entity dictating Virginia healthcare policies. That decision belongs to Virginians alone and our elected Virginia leaders. Help us fight the globalist agenda.
Please sign the petition from the Virginia Medical Freedom Alliance to Stop the World Health Organization in Virginia.
I have personally worked with Dr. Sheila Furey and her team at the VMFA to push back legislatively against the COVID mandated shots over the past 4 years and while serving you in the Senate of Virginia. You can trust Dr. Sheila Furey.
Please [Sign the Petition](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0013joTHineBn2TEMt-Q1_0hBfc32h10Pq1EJQoUsUc6vHb1b9e6d_6KW9uhf61lmwbqZIvoLkRMxCrpRdCHYLeOPFniWj5tLONEkS-Gzdwb4kT5wc3JC2raIHJ1EEI3Ss4as-u5VO2dctnokfjtCREwsHpXwBZO_MfJet6iDCixILbvTMpTgdXEHyr7LSdnhfAGKYMOEv17T86MayqHKfEe0uJ7-M496YI_93BKLD5rsnhwF7XJpdBvxp4lR3LaK3TpUvXLRnxaMa7Q2cxJpDNKK06bcUdD2ahSPfdgithyGzV74eOo3HlmWMtthcgzzYvjZOFsC-mgCUphu_oGH8ewqpFnJ7Gsnz-&c=c14ZEA6I6FgvC4-ucem85-Ngc-bWniWdFN_OZIPD-4RnDWdUExjFuA==&ch=emSOEoLSMqQcZfkMe2uBaPvoCyiY6P9Z7b9HbnXSc9qeA2h-cYQy1w==) to Governor Youngkin and Attorney General Miyares to join the fight in pushing back against mandatory vaccines and any other healthcare policy the WHO tries to force on Virginians.
In my conversations with Governor Youngkin, he was okay with private businesses mandating the Covid vaccine to their employees. While I respect the Governor, I strongly disagree with the governor on this policy position. I support an individual's right to refuse experimental vaccines, such as the highly controversial Covid shot. This shot has shown to have numerous dangerous side effects to include death. Individuals should not be forced to chose between putting food on the table for their family and being a lab rat. ## Student Protests Erupt Across Ivy League
Pro-Palestinian student protests [spilled across the Ivy League](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQxvGnsTciOMDggaFLtnTtaJ3hnFyFjWVoorx95c4dP33LT_-v23RDzrzdP3Gl0JYyYWz8pMkI0ALMZPoUFiIg3VNQTmnvrHbQP4JdrB7naMkhJakIRlTJmwUHT7NO0HMACUYa0NLbAeCS_KxkjG7W1uLgXGckJW7luHwX3tqDlvwuTzousax9Do_W9trpjw6uHVxx3-hVz-scR-OYqYNrLPlnnRnFGzMJrgdSFjtmqo03xq2K_SiNaqvCDlGnMUkE56OylDwZpQGdJRztOPZHSPuLc-Y6nLb7ipz_LO3fMr8BAAD__0q9ZNA) Monday as police arrested dozens at Yale, the gates to Harvard Yard were closed to the public, and Columbia shut down in-person classes for security reasons. The protests drew [bipartisan fire from Congress](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuhDAQBNCvgc4I1jb2FS7S0F3alGgNy7GJwcj2HcnfR6ROM81Io6f5uI935MD74x03cmWJI06FXzQqAVKAGlU9u4UISNbkOtNJa7Q0UK9OaW2UVeg70J4I0Zpe2QVurbyh7U3NDlpQrQLZWt0DNLP1XTtNxkutsTemUi3NXGJqPiPvZaUl_MQXpWaKWx3cWsqRK_lWwVDBcJ5ng98c89VWMFzbFQztFQAVDFMMz80ziiPFQrlkMSc8hecDU-GMu0jkn1-UxZLiJk7MK--PEvc6ufk4OQTO_WV6bMjhz1D-feQ3AAD__8bqYeY) and the White House, where they were condemned as antisemitic. Jewish Reps. Josh Gottheimer, Dan Goldman, and Jared Moskowitz planned to walk with Jewish students and speak at Columbia, the center of the firestorm. Police arrested 100 students at Columbia last week but said Monday that the school wouldn't allow them on its campus, which is private property. At Yale, [police arrested 45 protestors](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQBb_GdEb2GjBXuEhDd2lTImPvHRsZG-HNofv7iNTp3ug1o_m6z3dPifLz02_o-FFmH5heOHcSjIRu7proHoiApkGnrTaj7Y2FZnUq4BJvCMpgHMZbVDjoRQ8hBlRGW92QAwWd6sCosR8A2jguWoVgF9P3frBWdAojcTna70KZV3ykd3nh0YayNcmtzHsV5kPAJGA6z7MNS8141usXMF1TwPT2CWXln4iZq4y4lVz58FyOi9hTxij9RlHuR5G7T1iZMvl8MWNlAVNzuLiflBLV4dJ6bp7Snwb_G-U3AAD___3NZkI) Monday for blocking entry to Beinecke Plaza in "solidarity with Gaza."
## Opening Arguments Heard in Trump Trial
Opening arguments in former President Donald Trump's so-called ["hush money" trial began Monday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGypSAQRL8GMywcUDQw2ITsbbqhNQ_GK1sIlsy9ln-_5cYv6TpBB6f7z9fyhTHF_PqNO828lgU9xw8tRoKWYBbThHklAtINzZ3t9Gh7baHZZhxwMt6EgAhqCDjZiSwMwwreT53BJs6gwCgDWo39ANCG8btT3ttv3fc4WCuMohC5nO3fEjNvtKa7fOhsfdmbNG_MRxX6lwAnwF3X1b4rcgl4PwUBrnI5bwEu01UFuKOkyNE_SIk8x5IffiQEOPUEgADH53s_ZKCVciVZDsoxv2RlZNopc5Xbu25yL5lu6bGSAGe16aDTo1JWgGvOORxXTCnW4Rnx2jGm_9L844X_AgAA___4FnFO), with attorneys for both sides making their opening arguments. Prosecutors claimed Trump used lawyer Michael Cohen to cover up payments intended to hide an alleged involvement with adult film actress Stormy Daniels. They said they would tie that to a "conspiracy" to influence the 2016 election. In rebuttal, Trump's defense lawyer [minimized all the charges,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtygzAQAL9GdPJIpwd2oSINndOmZAQccImQGHHY47_POHXqLXZnv-79PVKivHzGDQPPpY8j0wN7K8FIsL1tpjAjApoGg261ubbOtNCsQRk7axycvw06ghu8Ny0qNdmb8XrSuqEACqyyYNTVeYDLdB20Gsd2MM5F37bCKpyIS718F8q84pxe5YH1MpatSWFl3g9hPgR0AjpecaWU3kxAV3E5U2QqWUA3lrOyHCJzwkNAZ7022jjpJMcfjM_4OuRcyybLjpnyImNdzg0zH5Ky5BUl13PbJVeKSUDX1DDtT0qJDv-OXLZIf-KG_130GwAA___s8mgt) calling Cohen a known liar and shrugging off the conspiracy idea. "There's nothing wrong with trying to influence an election," said his lawyer. "It's called democracy." The court adjourned for the Passover holiday around noon and will return for another shortened session today.
## Baseball's Food Game Weighs Heavily on Fans
For the millions of fans expected to visit baseball stadiums this summer, the real contest could be choosing between a two-pound chicken tender called the "Fowl Pole" or a simple bag of popcorn. For a dieter, the options available at a modern ballpark can be terrifying: Cleveland offers the[ slider dog: a hot dog](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAURL8Gd1j2BYJdUKRx85TXrVJaGK4TVmAiuLGVv1956-1GGo3m6Nxv882GGLbHf5vQ0Jpn6yjsOEsOgoOcZePNiggoGjS97sWgldDQPM2oR2H14hwqZQdn_TqsvUfl5DiosVNNMNCB7CSIblAXgNYPS985pxehlL1ozWSHPlAu7XcOGz1xjZ-8Y2ldTk00T6JXZeLKYGIwHcfRprqdHYMJN_6uDKb6yoXOkOLCYFqwEl9z9jwQJm6J447lw1NceCXrw_sc28Kv134L_77uTTH-dYQYQ72cPI9kQ_z9pz9t_AQAAP__XkNhCQ) with mac-and-cheese, bacon, and Froot Loops; Kansas City features a BBQ Reese's Sandwich, which mixes pulled pork and peanut butter cups; and in Atlanta, the Braves have the Blooper Burger -- beef, cheese, hot dog, chicken tenders, jalapenos, and cheese sauce. Nutrition experts offer the following strategies [for those looking to eat healthy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2PtCAURn-NdBq4IFcLirexm7fd0vBxGdmgGGFnsv9-49ZbPnmKc3I-HuvDppyO53-7k2mxrNa39KJV9SB7UKtiwUQiIMnICBRywlEisM3MgmME7x3woKOw0gWBPiJaN8k5SpYMcFBcgeTTqAGGMDnBvUcnx9FqxE5xCqmVa_gs6WgbxfxdXnQNvuwsm621s3byXwdLB4s9D3rX-7rH1ZLP1MFSmw3pa-_rWa5W-1hK6GfPnRKIU7Bz0KBncojRgdJSEI6cXSac75RzqvqWeO425V9o-zPBTwAAAP__xXZbUw): try walking a few laps around the ballpark before making a selection or simply sticking with baseball's lower-calorie standards: peanuts and a plain low-carb hot dog.

body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-m/) Chag Pesach Sameach Today we celebrate Passover, a holiday which commemorates the emancipation of the Israelites from slavery in ancient Egypt. It is a holiday of celebration and the passing of tradition, connecting generations of Jews across the world to their ancestors and the suffering and liberation that they experienced. To our Jewish friends and neighbors in the 10th District and those all throughout Illinois, the United States, and abroad, we stand in solidarity and celebrate this important holiday with you - Chag Pesach Sameach! [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-r/) Team Carris,As the war in Israel continues, I am encouraged by the bipartisan support of the $95 billion legislative package providing security assistance to Ukraine, Israel and Taiwan that was passed this weekend in the House of Representatives. As the Senate prepares to vote on Tuesday, I encourage them to remain steadfast in this important act of allyship, particularly to Israel, our strongest ally in the Middle East. While steps of progress are made, threats to the Jewish community are at an all time high both at home and abroad. As families sit around the Seder table tonight, many in Israel will do so without their loved ones. I will especially keep the families of the hostages in my prayers. Providing aid is progress and now we must focus on bringing the hostages home. They are not forgotten and we must act to return them to their families. In Illinois, Jewish families, students, and organizations face the rise of antisemitic incidents, including harassment, vandalism and assault. According to [a new report](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-y/) by the Anti-Defamation League (ADL), 8,873 antisemitic incidents were reported in the United States in 2023, a staggering 140 percent increase from 2022 and the highest recorded number of incidents since the ADL began tracking antisemitic incidents in 1979. Of the 8,873 incidents, Illinois had 211 in 2023, compared to 121 in 2022 and 53 in 2021. "The dramatic increase in incidents took place primarily in the period following the October 7 terrorist attacks in Israel." The report also looks at the significant increase of incidents in schools, including K-12 schools.We must act swiftly and work across the aisle to address these issues head on.
* Our elected representatives must vote to financially support our allies - to assist humanitarian efforts and also to strengthen the United States' national security position.
* The Biden administration must demand the release of the Israeli hostages. To do less than is unacceptable.
* We must actively work to eradicate discrimination of all kinds - especially antisemitism - during this time of global strife. Whether at home, on a college campus, or worshiping high holidays, no person should feel fear expressing their freedom of religion.

Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Listening to the Business Community**
Small businesses are the cornerstone of our economy and the 10th District is full of incredible family-owned and operated ventures that improve our local economy and bring business to our communities. I want to thank Berger Excavating Contractors for generously welcoming me to meet with several other local business owners to talk about the economy, restrictions on businesses, and what I plan to do to help stimulate business growth once in office. 🇺🇸 **Celebrating Law Enforcement**
I was thrilled celebrate the Lake County Sheriff's Office retirement ceremony for K9 Dax, who joined his partner, Deputy John Forlenza, at the Sheriff's Office in 2015. Together, they have located over 400 missing endangered people or fleeing felons, seized hundreds of kilos of illegal drugs, millions of dollars, and dozens of firearms and vehicles. They have also participated in hundreds of community and school demonstrations. On March 3, 2024, Dax was injured while apprehending a person who had committed several felonies, and was fleeing. His team of veterinarians determined that he would not be able to return to active duty and while Dax unfortunately passed away a few days after his ceremony, we are grateful to him and Deputy Forlenza for their dedication to the people of Lake County. 🇺🇸 **Tuning into Lake County 's Housing Landscape**
As a decades-long resident of Lake County and a business professional with a commercial real estate background, it's incredibly important to me to be informed about the state of fair housing, affordable housing options, and the County's long-term plans for affordable housing for individuals with disabilities, seniors, and those experiencing housing insecurity. I attended the Housing and Community Development Commission where we heard from County officials, experts, and commision members about current affordable housing development updates and the creation of the 2025-2029 plan. It was invaluable to hear the tenant, landlord, and diverse perspectives on the needs in communities like North Chicago, Waukegan, and others. 🇺🇸 **Putting Heart Into Youth Development in Waukegan**
I had the pleasure of spending some time with the leadership and students of Heart of the City on the soccer field in Waukegan. Founded in 2014, Heart of the City strives to level the playing field for over 1,100 youth in underserved communities in Lake County. Using soccer as the vehicle, their programs are designed to provide a developmental pathway for youth to build social-emotional and leadership skills, access academic support, and earn stackable credentials for postsecondary education and employment success. Under the outstanding leadership of Executive Director Rena Lee, the program is growing and we're thrilled to support the work that they are doing to help families in our District. Join us in helping Heart of the City! To learn more, visit [heartofthecitysports.org](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-j/). Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Join Team Carris** **Volunteer with Us**
We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-t/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-i/) **Check Out Our Summer Internship Opportunities**
Calling all students and recent grads! Are you looking to join a dynamic team of volunteers this summer to work on a congressional campaign? Apply today to join Team Carris for a summer internship. As a Team Carris Intern, you will get experience working on a congressional campaign and learn the inner-workings of the campaign world. The program is open to high school students, college students, and recent graduates - no prior campaign experience is required. [Click Here to Apply](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-d/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-h/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-k/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-n/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiykukt-tlidtddjku-p/) **Support Carris for Congress** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: happening TOMORROW
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

As I write you this email, President Joe Biden is preparing to head to Tampa, Florida **TOMORROW** to deliver another rant about expanding abortion to kill more innocent preborn babies – especially in the Sunshine State.

With your help, _Students for Life Action_ is going to “welcome” him with an on-the-ground protest in Tampa with several student activists, pro-life signs, and our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck!**

Florida has become one of the most critical states ahead of the 2024 elections – especially since the State Supreme Court ruled to add a pro-abortion Ballot Initiative to their ballot come November.

That’s why _Students for Life Action_ has been ramping up our efforts in Florida over the past few months with several door knocking campaigns, Billboard Truck and Campus Tours, and even having me speak on campuses!

You and I can’t let Florida turn into the “abortion tourism” destination of the South – and that’s just what President Biden and his radical administration want.

But with all this happening **TOMORROW,** we need to raise the last-minute funds to get as many Florida students mobilized as quickly as possible with the resources they need!

**[So, will you please consider making your most generous contribution to help provide all of our pro-life activists with the signs and materials they need to send a strong message to President Biden tomorrow](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glyhlhl-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, our **Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck** has been on the road this past week across Florida for our _“No on 4 Tour”_ to fight against the Sunshine State’s Ballot Initiative and call attention to our Election Year Programs.

In fact, our massive electronic Billboard Truck will expose the harsh reality of abortion that President Biden is struggling to protect.

There’s no way they’ll be able to ignore us now.

**[Will you please consider making your most generous contribution possible to _Students for Life Action_ to help us come up with the funds we need to get this Pro-Life Video Billboard Truck to Tampa](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-glyhlhl-duchtdja-j/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, it could not be more important that we have your prayers and support.

Please be as generous as you can while we try to change hearts and minds one state at a time.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

name: Dr. Michael Mann
subject: Climate change is the greatest threat to humanity – But it isn’t too late to act...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
I’m a world renowned climate scientist and wanted to share my personal thoughts with you
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T99abf7b6-8267-4ad0-a303-920721e9bd15/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| | | | | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T99ecd5d2-2f3d-45e7-9490-c1eeb7a12c15/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that [in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb39f1c53-fc33-425e-b220-a8661c3a06b9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: [Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Blue Amp Action ahead of their deadline at midnight? They are working to elect climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government and they can’t do this work without you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb2f80957-8400-46aa-bbcf-e779f279bba5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country. [Our window to act is closing. So I’m asking you to act: Join me in supporting 314 Action and Blue Amp Action. Let’s elect a historic wave of Democratic scientists who will lead the fight on climate. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfca78bce-6cc0-4213-a451-8fa40b68ad0c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---

| Thank you, Dr. Michael Mann Climate Scientist & Geophysicist
Presidential Distinguished Professor of Atmospheric Science at University of Pennsylvania
Director of Penn Center for Science, Sustainability and the Media
World Sustainability Award Recipient 2019
Tyler Prize for Environmental Achievement Recipient

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection. By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: Criminals over cops?
body:
I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

Dear Friend,

I know you and I have never met. But I'm praying that you'll help me save my son, Officer Terence Sutton.

This is a picture of Terence and me at a dinner celebrating his graduation from the Police Academy.
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569cda2d7533468d96548e6e7d1e0ddb&_e=wK9stV7z_9XuwIfdA8ALWEKQSk2b9HB-09Ds8TEFRqw0qsOpL5jY2Cc9lz7L-Nv77fYco2qp_xXu1mM2HWV3HwbyaYu_Q4PKjXT4_NHZzJx1-GVHcDRPhouXge0VpCnkDJJSr4wg7h0NDPKJ9jYtgOmHcNtug73dpAnGNfqwnCnNcg_wTsA5DP7mlJqIZqCTqkuLKgyEW24zgKktD0gL6VSu70XYQb1j7107AAc2NQB1WOuIA227nfEMiE81WvzSb3ci-ro9jPbE89AcZqiZ_lkHfKKjwFbfngiFFXv2angh0OrfDXH1efSWGMChQdziidSVHOXX0im9k2FCtzjAdwsDmjk48s9x6C4nqJA6DhtBIGTgjXPzRzRkBgvfwTtZ)
I was so proud that night. But I was also terrified.

Terence was going to be patrolling the streets of Washington, DC, where crime is sky-high and politicians side with criminals over cops. But never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

The story is so shocking that if it didn't happen to my son, _I wouldn 't even believe it._ **[And I'm praying you will help me save my son](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569cda2d7533468d96548e6e7d1e0ddb&_e=wK9stV7z_9XuwIfdA8ALWEKQSk2b9HB-09Ds8TEFRqw0qsOpL5jY2Cc9lz7L-Nv77fYco2qp_xXu1mM2HWV3HwbyaYu_Q4PKjXT4_NHZzJx1-GVHcDRPhouXge0VpCnkDJJSr4wg7h0NDPKJ9jYtgOmHcNtug73dpAnGNfqwnCnNcg_wTsA5DP7mlJqIZqCTqkuLKgyEW24zgKktD0gL6deAvlHye1djokl041jqtBNeEvIWA4NTfPqPFKwiQjrnW4gs8f0Fb_XdbEa26R8SfKLVSJ_xseTGG3bEstlM-f7dOKbZrmVt0GJmdjfIQxQDmz2T7b5RI4ag03bNUK1_0iZuGy-d1EFL5PGd91vHLH-RZAOj9MYPCnidbBfhnn3B)** - **but first, let me explain what happened.**

Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he had been seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

So when Terence saw him illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull Karon over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

And then it happened.

Karon veered into an alleyway, drove out the other side without looking and slammed into a passing car.

After several days in the hospital, Karon died from his injuries. And here's where the story takes a shocking turn...

Because Karon was black, and the incident happened just four months after George Floyd's death, the anti-police mob went into frenzy.

They blamed Terence for the accident and smeared him as a racist.

There were protests and even riots. The mob threw rocks at officers, smashed store windows, and set fires.

Anti-police politicians piled on too. Without any evidence, they demanded my son be charged even though he did nothing to cause Karon's death.

The pressure campaign worked, and prosecutors charged my son with _**Second-Degree Murder.**_

When Terence called to tell me about the charges, I was in disbelief. Any sane person could see that Karon's death, while tragic, was no one's fault but his own.

_He_ chose to run from the cops.

_He_ chose to not wear a helmet.

_He_ chose to speed through that alley without looking where he was going.

So, when I learned that Terence could be sentenced to **_sixty_ _years_** in prison for Karon's death, my head started spinning. And it only got worse when the trial began.

You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense.

The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang...

They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before...

They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg...

And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash.

Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence _**" guilty."**_

He's currently awaiting sentencing.

Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear.

My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them.

He was even awarded Officer of the Year!

And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free...

...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he _didn 't_ _do._

I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the **Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund** -or LELDF for short.

If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment.

Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence.

So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone:

**[Will you help my son Terence fight the unjust charges against him by donating to LELDF?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569cda2d7533468d96548e6e7d1e0ddb&_e=wK9stV7z_9XuwIfdA8ALWEKQSk2b9HB-09Ds8TEFRqw0qsOpL5jY2Cc9lz7L-Nv77fYco2qp_xXu1mM2HWV3HwbyaYu_Q4PKjXT4_NHZzJx1-GVHcDRPhouXge0VpCnkDJJSr4wg7h0NDPKJ9jYtgOmHcNtug73dpAnGNfqwnCnNcg_wTsA5DP7mlJqIZqCTqkuLKgyEW24zgKktD0gL6Sxkpj9In1HrIEVw7TTvT8lCFgyqA78Kv2eqQmXZPSofnkufSr5JNr4ekZ_yFTGA0sMVtuU-rUZ9Tva7D8oMaf0YtYYKalJVEgCCtg8e3-oOSyBg3xxU32wsMHFpJ2BO-4JXyZwQvAzZ0VYfLoQCqm6VB6S-zpeGoAcoRF3HL0Ff)**

To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left.

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now.

I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me.

**[So if you are at all able, would you consider following this link to make a tax-deductible donation to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund to help my Terence?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569cda2d7533468d96548e6e7d1e0ddb&_e=wK9stV7z_9XuwIfdA8ALWEKQSk2b9HB-09Ds8TEFRqw0qsOpL5jY2Cc9lz7L-Nv77fYco2qp_xXu1mM2HWV3HwbyaYu_Q4PKjXT4_NHZzJx1-GVHcDRPhouXge0VpCnkDJJSr4wg7h0NDPKJ9jYtgOmHcNtug73dpAnGNfqwnCnNcg_wTsA5DP7mlJqIZqCTqkuLKgyEW24zgKktD0gL6S4t96x1a_KM3CD5jjPMVgX3p4i_CgOI5yqBSszg0VApCQ-N_q46NtcZeDM9zkH-QhTmwMH4t9i1hO8sfcvlkqUBeg24GTeEVIBZ5KznaW8G8Ir1tl2U7WqQIS2vppAhPlrtmxz9EjBBEj-AOHYbp3AneNEOx7QFzrBRxcdy5584)**

**Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help.**

And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly.

Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive.

**[And you and your $35 contribution could make the difference in Terence being acquitted or spending the next 60 years behind bars.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569cda2d7533468d96548e6e7d1e0ddb&_e=wK9stV7z_9XuwIfdA8ALWEKQSk2b9HB-09Ds8TEFRqw0qsOpL5jY2Cc9lz7L-Nv77fYco2qp_xXu1mM2HWV3HwbyaYu_Q4PKjXT4_NHZzJx1-GVHcDRPhouXge0VpCnkDJJSr4wg7h0NDPKJ9jYtgOmHcNtug73dpAnGNfqwnCnNcg_wTsA5DP7mlJqIZqCTqkuLKgyEW24zgKktD0gL6Q4vOPI8zwK1ILV5rC6Jz6xXaCOPlHM7joZ15IGCg2Z_m5nwHpZwACASupge7Om_pTLUwrVchjFgeglTWk95Logtc4lTsUYB9RupmYTXDaATjC8Saf28gTFLQtnN9f0zJKmfdYo8kE_TDUoWKbj9JFIPfo9tyABGBQHncC1TCcyW)**

Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you.

Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today.

And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence.

Sincerely,

Patti Reilly

P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. **[So if you choose to make a $35 gift to LELDF, would you also please include a little note-maybe a prayer?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=569cda2d7533468d96548e6e7d1e0ddb&_e=wK9stV7z_9XuwIfdA8ALWEKQSk2b9HB-09Ds8TEFRqw0qsOpL5jY2Cc9lz7L-Nv77fYco2qp_xXu1mM2HWV3HwbyaYu_Q4PKjXT4_NHZzJx1-GVHcDRPhouXge0VpCnkDJJSr4wg7h0NDPKJ9jYtgOmHcNtug73dpAnGNfqwnCnNcg_wTsA5DP7mlJqIZqCTqkuLKgyEW24zgKktD0gL6XVNOnOtyoC7tYTRITxkadgzww1kOrbtEkIzuuPDbdyYPj__AfSXTAuvc9ByQKkNQqrgcYRlzvw5A-tP82J5H9zsUumWmByTPheTHLXK_ErilXoLpejiDBO6aYdXPixsPZUwQPtSTDvumL8M9tPD_g_16C71rbEI4DVa4967CzLf)** There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart.
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit**www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

And it only got worse when the trial began. You see, the judge refused to allow Terence's legal team to present all of the facts in his defense. The jury never got to hear that Karon was a known member of a violent gang... They never got to hear that he was wearing an ankle monitor because of a violent assault he had committed just weeks before... They never got to hear that he had drugs and thousands of dollars in cash strapped to his leg... And they never got to hear about the drugs in Karon's system at the time of the crash. Sitting in the courtroom, I couldn't believe my ears when the jury filed out and declared Terence " guilty." He's currently awaiting sentencing. Now you understand why I'm so heartbroken. The injustice is almost too much to bear. My son was well-respected by the community he served. He trained many Rookies and set a good example for all of them. He was even awarded Officer of the Year! And at the same time the bleeding-heart DC politicians are letting shoplifters, carjackers, and drug dealers walk away scot-free... ...they're trying to put my son - a decorated officer who has received 60 awards and commendations - away for 60 years for something he didn 't do. I had almost lost hope, but then we learned about the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund -or LELDF for short. If you've ever heard of LELDF, you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly-accused police officers like Terence. LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments. And when I got the call from their president, Jason Johnson, I was at my lowest moment. Not only did LELDF decide to help my son get the legal defense he deserves. They're also raising money to pay for the best attorneys and expert witnesses for Terence. So I have to ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone: To fund his defense, Terence had to sell his home, his car, his beloved motorcycle, and most of his personal belongings. Everything he owns now fits in just nine small boxes. He has almost nothing left. If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help. But I already lost my husband. He was a police officer too, and he was so proud that Terence followed in his footsteps. And it makes me cry when I think of how he would feel about what Terence is being put through right now. I simply can't bear the thought of having another family member ripped away from me. Any amount - $35, $50, $100, or even $500 or more - will help. And because LELDF is a non-profit organization, your gift is completely tax-deductible. But whatever you can afford to give, I ask that you rush it back quickly. Terence's team is currently looking at every available option to keep his case alive. Right now, Terence can only rely on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you. Thank you for taking the time to read my letter today. And thank you - in advance - for doing what you can to help all the wrongly-accused officers LELDF is working with. Like Terence. Sincerely, Patti Reilly P.S. I know a few kind words from someone like you will help lift Terence's spirits. This guilty verdict has been so devastating for him. There's a field on the page for you to do this. Thank you -from the bottom of my heart. More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visitwww.PoliceDefense.org. And remember -Blue Lives Matter! body: 96https://secure.winred.com/reddy-for-kansas-03/sharice-and-the-border-e mail-fundraising?utm_source=rc&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024april23 hf When Sharice Davids first ran for Kansas’ 3rd District in 2018, she said she wanted to defund Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). That’s the most substantial position she’s taken on border security, and that’s just plain wrong. But we can figure out where she stands by looking at her votes. Over the last three years, Sharice Davids has had one chance after another to vote for measures that would help end the crisis at our southern border. Here are a few of the things she’s voted against: —> Restarting construction of the border wall —> Ending catch & release —> Reimplementing the Remain in Mexico Policy —> Hiring more Border Patrol agents —> Strengthening the asylum process With her refusal to take tough votes and go against her party, Sharice Davids has enabled the worst border crisis in American history. I’m a legal immigrant. This issue is personal to me. On top of that, as a military officer, I know how critical border security is to America’s national security. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/23/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hello friends!
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, April 23, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Peter Yu final Republican to qualify for ballot in crowded 4th District GOP primary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The names of [six candidates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) seeking the Republican nomination will appear on the 4th District primary election ballot.
[Peter Yu](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) was the final candidate to qualify Monday, when he narrowly cleared the 1,500-vote threshold needed. He submitted petitions with 2,464 signatures, with 62.9% (1,552) accepted by the Secretary of State's office.
He joins a [crowded field](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of Lauren Boebert, Deborah Flora, Richard Holtorf, Mike Lynch and Jerry Sonnenberg on the ballot. Boebert earned 40% support of delegates at the Republican assembly earlier this month to qualify for the ballot, in addition to the first successful petition in the district. Flora and Lynch qualified through petition only. Holtorf and Sonnenberg qualified through the combination of assembly and petition.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Kroger plans to sell Safeway brand in Colorado to prevent merger block](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Kroger and Albertsons, [under regulatory pressure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), plan to sell nearly 600 stores nationwide, including the Safeway brand in Colorado, as part of their proposed $24.6 billion merger.
* The agreement involves selling 579 stores to C&S Wholesale Grocers, [affecting 91 Albertsons-owned locations in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Under the deal, Kroger will license the Safeway name to C&S in Colorado and Arizona, aiming to address concerns raised by regulators.
* The move is a [response to lawsuits from government officials](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including the FTC, citing fears of reduced competition and higher grocery prices. The deal, worth nearly $3 billion, aims to introduce a [new competitor to Colorado's grocery market]() while ensuring continued service to communities.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Supreme Court could pave the way for homeless camp bans in hearing of anti-camping complaint](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Supreme Court will hear a case from Grant Pass, Oregon, concerning fines imposed for violations of its [anti-camping ordinance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with implications for homelessness regulation nationwide.
* Lower courts found the ordinance [constituted cruel and unusual punishment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), affecting efforts to combat homelessness in several states. The case raises questions about the power of cities to regulate homelessness and the constitutionality of anti-camping ordinances.
* Legal experts speculate on potential outcomes, including [reevaluation of the Establishment Clause ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)and the application of cruel and unusual punishment standards.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Rural"cowboy up" culture has led to high suicide rates. How can the state improve mental health in ag?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* [High suicide rates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in rural Colorado's agricultural communities prompt initiatives to improve mental health support.
* Mental health workshops like [Buck the Trend](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) aim to address mental health struggles among farmers, ranchers, and horse people. Isolation, financial stress, and cultural norms contribute to the mental health challenges faced by those in the agriculture industry.
* Legislative efforts include bills to [allocate state funds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for suicide prevention programs and mental health awareness campaigns tailored to agricultural workers. Despite challenges, efforts are underway to reduce stigma, increase awareness, and provide accessible mental health resources in rural Colorado.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[COMMENTARY: Opposition to Trump is rooted in contempt for ordinary voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LOUIS MARKOS, [THE FEDERALIST ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A complaint I hear increasingly leveled at contemporary American politicians is that they are out of touch with voters, if not downright contemptuous of them._
_On a number of core issues, politicians seem less concerned with pursuing policies that are deeply unpopular with ordinary Americans than with upholding the ideologies and self-interests of the ruling elite. Two dramatic examples of this political disconnect with average citizens are the refusal of urban governments to prosecute violent criminals, which has caused a surge in crime, and the White House 's tolerance of mass immigration, which threatens jobs, security, and the rule of law._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Flora gathers support of Phelen, Trujillo as they exit 4th District primary race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 20** _As they hit the exit in the 4th District U.S. House Republican Party primary race, two candidates this week threw their support to Deborah Flora._
**[Bids end for Granado in 3rd District, Trujillo in 4th with failure to qualify for GOP primary ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 19** _Both Joe Granado in the 3rd District and Floyd Trujillo in the 4th District failed to provide the necessary signatures to qualify for the ballot, the Secretary of State 's office announced Friday._
**['We should cease reintroduction now': Republican legislators sound off on wolves killing more livestock](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 19** _The results of reintroduction of gray wolves into western areas of Colorado is drawing the ire of many Republican members of the State Legislature, several of whom earn a living from livestock._
**[Rep. Jake LaTurner of Kansas joins Republican run for the exit in Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | NATIONAL | APRIL 19** _Eastern Kansas Rep. Jake LaTurner announced Thursday he won 't seek re-election to his seat in the U.S. House after less than two terms._

| This day, as we reflect on key movements like the Environmental Justice and Freedom Summer of 1964, we are reminded of the ongoing struggle for justice and equality.
